summary: Lists short-term requirements for how trusted SIP network nodes pass along a Network Asserted Identity, which is an identity a network intermediary derives after authenticating a user. Unlike a self-chosen alias, it is vouched for by the network. The scope is trusted, securely interconnected networks.

eli5.summary: Anyone can say their name is anything. This document lists what is needed so a trusted phone company can vouch for who someone really is, and pass that on to other trusted companies.

questions: what are the requirements for sip asserted identity
